discordPostHtml:
This mod is an addon to Diable Avionics adding in 5 ships.

  • Godhead - A 5 module super capital carrier designed to be a glass cannon. Tried to balance it to take on fleets, but can still be lost if you're not careful.
  • Mirage - A large destroyer class phase ship, fragile but has a lot of weaponry.
  • Drought - Capital class Mining / Salvage ship
  • Flood - Tanker / Freighter Capital class logistics ships that store 10000 Antimatter / cargo for their respective types

All ships have ornate, base, and stripeless paintjobs.

Mod is in a relatively early state of development with a few issues. Ships might be poorly balanced, I've done a full playthrough and tried to tune them to be fun.

Download github:
https://github.com/PitchBrightWhite/Mad-Avionics/tree/main

Sprite .kra files
https://github.com/PitchBrightWhite/Mad-Avionics-Spriting-Kit

Further details in comments.
